content.src: 岳堂主在众人之前大声道：“大家听好，从竹林中的小路往前走，可以到达七玄门的炼骨崖，第一段路是竹林地段，再来是岩壁地带，最后是一个山崖，能到崖顶的才能进入七玄门，要是正午前无法到达，虽然不能成为正式弟子，但要是表现有可圈可点之处，可以收为记名弟子
content.target: Leader Yue announced loudly in front of everyone, 'Listen up, everyone. Follow the path through the bamboo forest ahead, and you will reach the Bone Refining Cliff of the Seven Mysteries Sect. The first part is the bamboo forest area, then comes the rocky cliff zone, and finally, there is a mountain cliff. Only those who reach the cliff top can enter the Seven Mysteries Sect. If you fail to arrive by noon, you won’t become a formal disciple, but if you show some promise, you may be accepted as a nominal disciple.'

content.src:
”

韩立自然不明“记名弟子”的含义，只知道反正要往前走要爬山就是了，向前眺望了一眼，是一面不算陡峭的山坡，许多根粗细不一的长竹长在坡上，似乎没有多难爬啊
content.target: Han Li didn’t understand what a 'nominal disciple' meant. He only knew he had to move forward and climb the mountain. Looking ahead, he saw a not-too-steep slope covered with bamboo of varying thickness. It didn’t seem too hard to climb.

content.src: 韩立望望其他人，他可不愿输给同龄人，其他孩童之间，气氛也变的突然紧张起来
content.target: Han Li glanced at the others. He didn’t want to lose to his peers. The atmosphere among the other children also grew tense.

content.src: 岳堂主望了望日出的太阳说道：“时候差不多了，准备出吧
content.target: Leader Yue looked at the rising sun and said, 'It’s about time. Get ready to start.'

content.src: 不要害怕，师兄们会在后面护住你们的，不会让你们出危险
content.target: 'Don’t be afraid. Your senior brothers will follow behind to protect you and ensure your safety.'

content.src:
”

韩立回头望望身后那些青年人，原来这些人叫做师兄，大概就是以前收的弟子，自己若是也加入了，是不是可以穿同样神气的衣服
content.target: Han Li turned to look at the young men behind him. So these were called 'senior brothers,' probably former disciples. If he joined, could he wear the same impressive clothes?

content.src: 正在瞎琢磨之时，韩立现，其余的孩童都已冲进了竹林，见此情景，他连忙紧跟而去
content.target: While lost in thought, Han Li noticed the other children had already rushed into the bamboo forest. Seeing this, he quickly followed.

content.src: 竹林应该非常宽广，三十余名孩童，一冲进竹林就立即散了开来，韩立的身后紧随着一位瘦长的师兄，这人冷着脸孔，一言不的紧随他的身后，韩立有点害怕，不敢与其说话，只是抬起脚步，低着身子，慢慢的沿着斜坡，向前迈进
content.target: The bamboo forest seemed vast. As soon as the thirty or so children entered, they quickly scattered. A tall, thin senior brother followed closely behind Han Li, his face cold and silent. Han Li felt a little scared and didn’t dare speak to him. Instead, he lowered his body and slowly moved forward along the slope.

content.src: 这片竹林看起来不怎样，但是走时间长了就觉得辛苦了，腿走着走着越来越重，渐渐的韩立必须用一只手稍微拉着竹子的茎杆向前移动，好少费些力气
content.target: The bamboo forest didn’t look difficult at first, but after walking for a while, it became exhausting. His legs grew heavier with each step. Eventually, Han Li had to pull himself forward by grabbing bamboo stalks to save energy.

content.src: 这样坚持了好长时间，韩立实在累的够呛，只好随便找个土堆一屁股做了下来，然后不停地喘息着
content.target: After struggling for a long time, Han Li was completely worn out. He plopped down on a dirt mound, panting heavily.

content.src: 韩立抽空，回头望了一眼瘦长的师兄，虽然地面陡峭的很厉害，这位师兄居然仍然是动也不动的站着、身上一丝灰尘好像都没沾，与那些竹子一样的挺拔着，正在自己下面不远处静静地望着自己
content.target: Han Li took a moment to look back at his tall and thin senior brother. Despite the steep ground, the brother stood motionless, without a speck of dust on him, as straight as the bamboo around him, quietly watching Han Li from not far below.

content.src: 韩立看到师兄冷冷的目光，心中又有些害怕，忙把头转了回来，又听阵阵的喘气声不断从前面传来，知道是前面有爬的比自己快的人也在休息，韩立再稍微在原地呆了一会，就匆忙的往上赶去
content.target: Seeing the cold gaze of his senior brother, Han Li felt a bit scared and quickly turned his head back. Hearing heavy breathing from ahead, he knew others were resting after climbing faster than him. After pausing briefly, Han Li hurried upward.

content.src: 坡面倾斜的更厉害了，韩立浑身的力气也是越来越小，为了不会走着走着就站立不住，韩立只能躬下腰，手足并行，总算身上的衣服够结实，不然四肢的关节膝盖处就会被磨破
content.target: The slope became even steeper, and Han Li's strength was fading. To avoid losing balance, he had to bend down and crawl on all fours. Luckily, his clothes were sturdy, or his knees and elbows would have been scraped raw.

content.src: 终于快走出了这片茂密的竹林，韩悝却只觉得这最后一点路越来越难走，地面的岩石渐渐的多起来，相反竹子却越来越少
content.target: Finally nearing the end of the dense bamboo forest, Han Li found the last stretch increasingly difficult. The ground had more rocks and fewer bamboo plants.

content.src: 韩立终于再也不能拉着竹竿前进了，这最后的路程可以算是一米米的挪过去的
content.target: Han Li could no longer pull himself forward using the bamboo. The final part of the journey was a slow, inch-by-inch crawl.

content.src: 一走出竹林，只见眼前一阵宽广，正前面是一块巨大无比的山石，上面已经有了几个瘦小的身躯，正慢腾腾的向上攀爬，在他们身后也都跟着一个个衣服打扮一样的师兄，韩立当下不再犹豫，急忙往前方的巨石壁跑去
content.target: Once out of the bamboo forest, Han Li saw a vast open space ahead. A massive rock stood in front, with a few small figures slowly climbing it, each followed by a senior brother in similar attire. Without hesitation, Han Li rushed toward the rock wall.

content.src: 这块巨石的石壁是一片片、一层层的叠积岩，风化的很厉害，某些地方一碰到就会碎掉，当然也有许多坚挺着的碎石片，十分的锐利，只有一顿饭的功夫，韩立的双手就已伤痕累累，手肘、膝盖的衣服也已划破，里面的皮肉被割伤了不少处，即使伤口都很小，但是一些细细的碎石渣渗到里面，使得疼痛的感觉更添上几分
content.target: The rock wall was made of layered, weathered sedimentary rock. Some parts crumbled at a touch, while others had sharp edges. Within a short time, Han Li's hands were covered in cuts, his elbows and knees bruised, and tiny rock fragments embedded in his wounds made the pain worse.

content.src: 最前面几名已经越爬越远了，韩立想到家人和三叔嘱咐的话，只能在心底下又咬咬牙，又艰辛的往上爬
content.target: The leading climbers were far ahead. Remembering his family and uncle's words, Han Li gritted his teeth and pushed himself upward.

content.src: 临出之前，韩立的父亲和三叔已经提醒过韩立，入门的测试会很艰难，要是没坚持到底的话，是不可能加入七玄门，在这个时候，韩立心里早就不在乎入不入得了七玄门，只是心里头的一股狠劲作起来，这口气堵在里头，非要追上其他人不可
content.target: Before leaving, Han Li's father and uncle had warned him that the entrance test would be tough. Only by persevering could he join the Seven Mysteries Sect. Now, Han Li no longer cared about joining—his stubbornness drove him forward, determined to catch up with the others.

content.src: 韩立抬起头费力的望了望，现在爬在最前边的人是舞岩，舞岩毕竟比韩立长了不止一岁，还练过一些武功，身体比其他孩子强壮的多，爬在最前并不令人惊奇
content.target: Han Li looked up with effort. The person leading the climb was Wu Yan, who was older, had trained in martial arts, and was much stronger than the other children. It was no surprise he was ahead.

content.src: 韩立又回头扫视了后方几眼，后面还有不少人影在移动着，韩立吸了一口气，又加前进
content.target: Han Li glanced back a few more times. There were still many figures moving behind him. He took a deep breath and quickened his pace.

content.src: 吃奶的力气都使了出来，仍然没有拉近和最前边几人的距离，身子是越来越沉重，眼看太阳逐渐爬到天空的正中间，而舞岩却已经攀到巨石壁尽头
content.target: He used all his strength but still couldn't close the gap with the leaders. His body grew heavier as the sun climbed to the middle of the sky. Meanwhile, Wu Yan had already reached the end of the giant rock wall.

content.src: 那里是一处垂直陡峭的山崖，高有三十余丈，从山崖顶部悬吊下来十几条麻绳，麻绳上还打着一个个拳头大的结，舞岩现在正攀上其中一条，慢慢的一点一点的正在向崖顶移动
content.target: There was a steep cliff, over thirty zhang high. Dozens of thick ropes hung from the top, each with fist-sized knots. Wu Yan was climbing one of them, slowly making his way up.

content.src: 韩立望着前面的舞岩，有些灰心了，他知道自己不可能追上最前边数人，而且时间也不够了
content.target: Han Li looked at Wu Yan ahead and felt discouraged. He knew he couldn't catch up with the leaders, and time was running out.

content.src: 这念头一起，突然间手肘膝处的受伤处就同时传来了火辣辣的疼痛，四肢无力了，抓着岩石的一只手一颤，猛的全身都往下掉，韩立吓的心扑通扑通直跳，连忙把全身紧紧地贴在了石壁上面，动也不敢再动
content.target: As this thought crossed his mind, sharp pain flared in his elbows and knees. His limbs weakened, and his grip slipped. Suddenly, he started falling. His heart pounded in fear as he pressed his body tightly against the rock, not daring to move.

content.src: 过了一会儿，心中平静下来，再用手去抓住一块凸出的石角，扯了几下，比较牢靠，这才放心了下来
content.target: After a while, he calmed down. He reached for a protruding rock, tested its firmness, and felt relieved.

content.src: 韩立下意识的回头望了望，见到身后的师兄正半蹲着身子两手臂敞开，摆出了防护韩立的姿势，见到他又安全了，才缓缓的站直了身子
content.target: Han Li instinctively looked back and saw his senior brother crouching with arms outstretched, ready to protect him. Seeing Han Li was safe again, he slowly stood up.

content.src: 韩立心里一阵感激，自己要是真的掉下去，前面的辛苦可是白费了
content.target: Han Li felt grateful. If he had fallen, all his effort would have been wasted.

content.src: 于是稍歇片刻，又慢慢的向前移动，朝着挂在悬崖上的一条条粗麻绳爬去
content.target: After a short rest, he moved forward again, slowly making his way toward the thick ropes hanging from the cliff.

content.src: 终于来到了其中一条没人的麻绳，太阳已经几乎到了天空的正中间，只剩不到半个时辰就会完全到正午了，这时舞岩已经攀上了崖顶，正回头往下望，韩立爬到麻绳底部的时候恰好见到舞岩，只见他举起手臂，伸出小拇指对着崖下之人轻轻比了两下，接着哈哈一阵狂笑，便离开了
content.target: Finally, he reached an unoccupied rope. The sun was almost at its peak, with less than half an hour until noon. Wu Yan had already reached the top and looked down. As Han Li reached the base of the rope, he saw Wu Yan raise his arm, extend his little finger, and gesture mockingly before bursting into laughter and walking away.

content.src: 韩立心里一阵气恼，连忙捉往麻绳，往上攀爬
content.target: Han Li felt annoyed and quickly grabbed the rope to climb up.

content.src: 可是韩立已经全身上下，没有了一丝一毫的余力，现在几乎连绳结都抓不牢
content.target: But Han Li had no strength left in his body and could barely hold onto the rope knots.

content.src: 当他费了好大力气爬上了最末端一个绳结，一下坐在上面后，就觉得全身上下软绵绵的，连一根手指都动弹不得了，费力的扭头看了看，后面的石壁处还有一些孩童子坐在那里，正大口大口的喘着粗气，看来和自己一样用完了最后一丝的力气
content.target: When he finally climbed to the last knot and sat on it, he felt completely weak and couldn't move a finger. He turned his head with effort and saw other children sitting by the stone wall, panting heavily, having used up their last bit of strength like him.

content.src: 韩立心里头只能苦笑，自己太小看这次的测试，还好自己没有落在最后面，转头又看到那位冷冷的师兄
content.target: Han Li could only smile bitterly in his heart, realizing he had underestimated this test. At least he wasn't the last one. He then glanced at the cold senior brother.

content.src: 韩立犹豫了片刻后，还是决努把劲儿，再向上攀登一些，虽然在正午之前自己绝对无法爬到，可是就此不动岂不太难看了
content.target: After hesitating for a moment, Han Li decided to push himself and climb a bit higher. Even though he couldn't reach the top by noon, staying still would be too embarrassing.

content.src: 韩悝伸了伸有点僵硬了的双手，使起了刚刚恢复的一点力气，慢慢的顺着绳结往上挪动，但是这时韩立的双手已经完全不听使唤了，根本抓不住绳子，磨蹭了片刻，仍然未能有结果
content.target: Han Li stretched his stiff hands and used the little strength he had recovered to slowly move up the rope. But his hands wouldn't obey him anymore, and he couldn't grip the rope properly. After struggling for a while, he still couldn't make progress.
